The monoclinic cell is strongly indexed (M(20)=63.3), 82 observed peaks match with a mean 2theta error of 0.0052 degrees, and the submitted coordinates reproduce isolated intensities with correlation 0.9975. An independent full-profile check gives an unweighted Rwp of about 7.39%; the two other stoichiometrically allowed choices of the Ir-bearing 8f orbit give about 33.8-34.0%, resolving the principal element-ordering ambiguity. Although no comparable-score report was supplied and the original trace did not exhaustively instantiate lower-symmetry models, there are no material unexplained reflections, geometric defects, or surviving scientifically motivated alternatives likely to improve the candidate set.
